Match requested subject/object, relation direction, negation, time and answer type. A city in a birth sentence is not a date. In "A's manager B", B is the manager, not A. Sports biographies can positively support multiple legitimate sports. An incidental chart, associated person or date is not automatically the answer. Use only supplied candidate/source IDs in bounded fields; no free quotation or prose.
For EVERY candidate, judge fit: direct means the answer itself fills the exact requested relation for an allowed referent; wrong_argument is explicit role/type mismatch; incidental means occurrence without enough support; uncertain means unresolved. Select counter only for actual counterevidence, not mere absence. conflict=same_referent only for incompatible claims for the same entity/attribute/relevant scope, not legitimate namesakes or complementary facts. entity labels are provisional groups, not truth. scope=excluded only for an explicit question constraint, with constraint selecting a literal numeric phrase from the question; otherwise allowed/unknown. observed_slot describes the answer's ACTUAL role, not the role wanted by the question. Mere disagreement does not make a source false. Fill all opaque keys.
Independent polarity defense: for each candidate scan ALL documents for a positive assignment to the requested role. Positive assignment for an allowed distinct referent must be fit=direct and placed in SUPPORT even if the candidate is not famous or not in the first document. A support statement is not a counter. Counter requires an explicit negative/exclusion or incompatible statement about that exact referent, and cannot be justified by absence. A birth header (date1 - date2) supports date1, not merely prose Born on. Distinct people sharing a name, distinct works with one title, multiple sports and plural mascots may legitimately coexist. Role match and truth are separate axes: competing same-role values stay direct with conflict flagged. Unknown memory is not negative evidence. Recheck all wrong_argument labels against the source before returning.
